source: FIFA World Cup 26 Regulations, Annexe C (approved 19 March 2026)
description: Round-of-32 routing for the 8 best third-placed teams. PLACEHOLDER — replace this file with the full 495-entry Annexe C data. The current lookup is empty; thirdPlaceAllocation.allocateThirdsToBrackets() will throw loudly on any advancing-groups key until the full table is provided.

match_descriptions.M74: Winner E vs Best 3rd of ABCDF
match_descriptions.M77: Winner I vs Best 3rd of CDFGH
match_descriptions.M79: Winner A vs Best 3rd of CEFHI
match_descriptions.M80: Winner L vs Best 3rd of EHIJK
match_descriptions.M81: Winner D vs Best 3rd of BEFIJ
match_descriptions.M82: Winner G vs Best 3rd of AEHIJ
match_descriptions.M85: Winner B vs Best 3rd of EFGIJ
match_descriptions.M87: Winner K vs Best 3rd of DEIJL

usage: Given the 8 third-placed teams that advance, sort their group letters into an 8-character uppercase string (e.g. 'ABCDEFGH') and look it up in the 'lookup' dict. The returned object maps match IDs (M74, M77, M79, M80, M81, M82, M85, M87) to the third-placed team assigned to that match (e.g. '3F' means 'third-placed team from Group F').
